en.headline: Housing officer admits misconduct for falsely claiming approvals
en.dek: A 36-year-old Housing Department estate officer pleaded guilty at West Kowloon Magistrates’ Courts to misconduct in public office after failing to submit two applications.
body: A Housing Department estate officer has admitted a charge of misconduct in public office after she told two applicants their requests had been approved when she had never submitted them for review.

The Independent Commission Against Corruption said 36-year-old Ng Ming-yi, who has been suspended from duty, handled one application to add a family member to a public housing tenancy at Tai Wo Hau Estate and one request from a non-governmental organisation to hold a community activity between October 2022 and October 2024.

According to the ICAC, she did not submit either application to a housing officer for approval. Instead she informed the applicants that the Housing Authority had already approved them, unauthorisedly added names to a tenancy agreement and issued an approval letter under the department’s name.

Magistrate Hung Suet-yu adjourned sentencing to 10 November for a community service order report and ordered Ng to pay the government about HK$34,000 in compensation, equivalent to the additional rent the tenant should have paid. Ng had earlier been charged with fraud offences but pleaded guilty to the alternative misconduct charges.

zh.headline: 房署主任承認公職人員行為失當 誝稱加戶及活動申請獲批
zh.dek: 36歲房屋事務主任在西九龍裁判法院承認控罪，案件押後至11月10日判刑，須賠償約3.4萬元。
body: 房屋署一名房屋事務主任承認公職人員行為失當罪，她向兩名申請者誝稱房署已批准公屋增加家庭成員及舉辦社區活動的申請，惟實際上從未呈交審批。
廉政公署表示，36歲的被告吳明儀現已被停職。她在2022年10月至2024年10月駐大窩口邨房署辦事處期間，處理一宗加戶申請及一宗非政府機構社區活動申請時，未有將申請交房屋事務經理審批。
據廉署所述，被告卻向申請人聲稱申請已獲正式批准，並擅自在租約家庭成員名單上添加名字，又以房署名義發出批准信。相關申請者一直不知道申請從未獲批。
裁判官熊雪如將案件押後至11月10日判刑，以索取社會服務令報告，並頒令被告須向政府賠償約34,000元，相等於案中租戶本應支付的額外租金。被告早前被控欺詐，現承認交替控罪。
